item.title: Court reverses Beth Ann White's 4th offense DUI conviction
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - The Mississippi Court of Appeals reversed one of Beth Ann White's convictions and reaffirmed her other convictions. item.description: HINDS COUNTY, Miss. (WJTV) - The Hinds County Election Commission will not assist with the upcoming primary election.
